text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's finally the day of the Tokyo
Daishoten.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
There's so many people... And they're all
here to
watch the Tokyo Daishoten?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
But where did they all come from? It's
not like I
advertised it much.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: My fans? What do you mean?
choice_data_list: ファンが頑張ってくれたんだ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Smart Falcon opened up to her fans at
the
holiday handshake event.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Those very same fans went on to spread
the word
about the Tokyo Daishoten
themselves,
determined to make it the
biggest ever.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, well, this is a problem. Right
before the
big race and I'm getting all
emotional.
choice_data_list: みんな、君の想いを知ってくれてる
みんな、貴方の想いを知ってくれてる

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
But I wasn't wrong. I'm glad I continued
running.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
My fans are all with me, giving me so
much
support.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: As an Umadol, I couldn't be happier!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
choice_data_list: この最高のステージで、輝くことだ
この最高のステージで、輝くことだよ

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, you're right. How could I
forget? ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
My happiness comes from standing on
the stage!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna get out there in front of
everyone, and
I'm gonna win! After that,
I'm gonna sing and
dance and convey my
feelings to everyone!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Because today's the day I become a top
Umadol
and shine like a star!
